note: Moments cut from the owner's own published videos and clips (YouTube @halmic, Twitch halmictv). Source footage is not in the repo; download video-only up to 1080p (see README.md). Times are source seconds. crop (landscape, 16:9) and pcrop (portrait, any aspect, usually 3:2) are w:h:x:y in a 1280x720 reference frame (scaled to the real source size) and always exclude HUD text, captions, credits, name tags and facecam. The portrait cut lays the pcrop across the phone frame at full width with its centre at pc (fraction of the 960 px height, default 0.295) over a dark blurred copy of itself.
